title_zh: 机器人程序员:面向机器人操作的视频指导策略代码生成
one_line: SFT a code-writing VLM on 115k Video2Code programs synthesised from DROID videos to call a fixed API library; zero-shot sim and real-arm results.
one_line_zh: 用从DROID视频合成的11.5万条代码微调视觉语言模型,生成调用固定API库的策略代码,在仿真与真机上零样本评测。

title_zh: 反思式规划:用于多阶段长时程机器人操作的视觉语言模型
one_line: DAgger-style post-training relabels a VLM's own rollouts with an oracle expert; a diffusion world model supplies imagined futures for test-time reflection.
one_line_zh: 用特权专家重标注VLM自身轨迹做DAgger式后训练,并以扩散世界模型生成想象未来,在推理时反思修正动作。

title_zh: 通过可解释知识库结合大语言模型与符号推理的多机器人时序规划
one_line: LLM writes a Prolog knowledge base checked and repaired by consistency predicates, then symbolic planning and scheduling; evaluated by KB corrections plus one real demo.
one_line_zh: LLM生成Prolog知识库并经一致性检查与修复,再做符号规划与调度;以知识库修改量评估并辅以一次真机演示。

title_zh: Hi Robot:基于分层视觉-语言-动作模型的开放式指令跟随
one_line: A VLM trained on real plus synthetic prompts turns open-ended instructions and feedback into atomic commands for a pi0 VLA; real-robot trials on three platforms.
one_line_zh: 用真实加合成提示训练的VLM把开放指令与反馈转成原子命令交给pi0 VLA执行,在三种真实机器人上评测。

title_zh: Code-as-Symbolic-Planner:基于符号代码生成的基础模型机器人规划
one_line: A frozen LLM acts as code writer, checker and steerer for up to three rounds, producing symbolic TAMP solvers; tested in simulation and on arms.
one_line_zh: 冻结的LLM分别扮演代码生成、检查与引导角色,多轮写出符号求解器完成任务与运动规划,在仿真和真机上检验。

title_zh: UAV-VLRR:面向无人机搜救快速响应的视觉语言引导NMPC
one_line: GPT-4o and Molmo extract target and obstacle pixels, mapped to world coordinates for an NMPC with obstacle penalty; two indoor scenes, flight times only.
one_line_zh: GPT-4o与Molmo提取目标和障碍像素并映射为世界坐标交给带避障的NMPC,仅在两个室内场景测飞行时间。

title_zh: 迈向基于大语言模型的真实世界机器人操作自主强化学习
one_line: GPT-4 writes a shaped reward with terminal bonus plus success and failure code; SAC trains manipulation skills in simulation, with real demos.
one_line_zh: GPT-4根据任务描述写出带终止奖励的稠密奖励及成败判定代码,用SAC在仿真中训练操作技能并做真机演示。

title_zh: 面向大语言模型驱动机器人的安全护栏
one_line: A root-of-trust LLM grounds safety rules into LTL specs and control synthesis overrides unsafe plans; attack success falls from over 92% to under 3%.
one_line_zh: 根可信LLM把安全规则落地为LTL规约,控制综合替换不安全计划;攻击成功率从92%以上降至3%以下,含Jackal真机。

title_zh: 大语言模型赋能的通用空中智能体
one_line: A UAV prototype runs a 14B LLM onboard, prompted with VLM scene text and an action set; only plan text and scene descriptions shown.
one_line_zh: 机载计算平台运行14B大模型做任务规划,用VLM场景文本和动作集构造提示;仅展示规划文本与场景描述。

title_zh: SmartWay:面向零样本视觉语言导航的增强路点预测与回溯
one_line: GPT-4o navigator with history-aware prompts, finer turn options and a backtrack action over waypoints from an occupancy-aware predictor; R2R-CE and Turtlebot results.
one_line_zh: GPT-4o导航器结合历史感知提示、细粒度转向和回溯动作,路点来自占用感知预测器;在R2R-CE与Turtlebot上评测。

title_zh: Being-0：结合视觉语言模型与模块化技能的人形机器人智能体
one_line: A trained lightweight VLM Connector grounds GPT-4o plans into locomotion and manipulation skill commands; evidence is real humanoid trials versus the same agent without the Connector.
one_line_zh: 用轻量 VLM 连接器把 GPT-4o 的计划落到运动与操作技能命令，并以人形机器人真机试验对比去掉连接器的版本。

title_zh: AgentSpec：面向安全可靠 LLM 智能体的可定制运行时约束执行
one_line: A rule DSL intercepts each proposed agent action before execution and stops, escalates or corrects it; evidence spans code, embodied planning and driving scenarios.
one_line_zh: 用规则语言在执行前拦截智能体的每个动作并停止、确认或纠正，评测覆盖代码、具身规划与自动驾驶场景。

title_zh: DAHLIA：基于渐进式上下文代码生成与回合反馈的机器人长程操作
one_line: A frozen LLM writes a full code plan over pose-query and pick-place APIs with progressive few-shot examples; a VLM reporter triggers replanning between episodes.
one_line_zh: 冻结的 LLM 用渐进式示例写出调用位姿查询与抓放接口的完整代码计划，VLM 报告器在回合间触发重规划。

title_zh: REMAC：面向长程机器人操作的自反思、自进化多智能体协作
one_line: A VLM checks pre- and post-conditions of each subtask and stores reflections that revise later plans; evidence is RoboCasa tasks and a small real dual-arm study.
one_line_zh: VLM 检查每个子任务的前置与后置条件并积累反思来修订后续计划，在 RoboCasa 与小规模真机上验证。

title_zh: GenSwarm：基于语言模型的可扩展多机器人代码策略生成与部署
one_line: Off-the-shelf LLM agents turn a task description into constraint-checked skill code with VLM video feedback, deployed to robots; evidence is simulation trials versus code baselines.
one_line_zh: 现成 LLM 智能体把任务描述生成带约束检查的技能代码，经 VLM 视频反馈后部署到机器人，仿真试验对比代码基线。

title_zh: AuDeRe：基于大语言模型的机器人规划与控制策略自动决策与实现
one_line: A frozen LLM selects planning and control APIs and writes the glue code, retrying on errors; evidence is 100 simulated runs per scenario versus direct-prediction and code baselines.
one_line_zh: 冻结 LLM 选择规划与控制接口并编写衔接代码、遇错重试，在仿真中每场景 100 次对比直接预测与纯代码基线。

title_zh: 基于具身行动链推理与多模态基础模型的人形零样本移动操作智能体
one_line: GPT-4V scene text feeds a GPT-4 chain-of-action reasoner that emits primitives from a fixed humanoid action library; evidence is real-robot trials versus older planners.
one_line_zh: GPT-4V 场景文本输入 GPT-4 行动链推理，从固定人形动作库输出原语，真机试验对比较早期规划器。

title_zh: GeoNav：用双尺度地理空间推理增强 MLLM 的语言目标空中导航
one_line: A frozen MLLM is prompted with a schematic cognitive map and a hierarchical scene graph across navigate, search and localize stages; evidence is CityNav with module ablation.
one_line_zh: 冻结 MLLM 在导航、搜索、定位三阶段使用示意认知地图与层次场景图，在 CityNav 上评测并做模块消融。

title_zh: Phoenix：基于运动的自反思框架用于精细机器人动作纠正
one_line: A fine-tuned MLLM predicts and corrects coarse motion instructions that condition a diffusion policy; evidence is RoboMimic closed-loop trials and a small real drawer task.
one_line_zh: 微调 MLLM 预测并纠正粗粒度运动指令来驱动扩散策略，在 RoboMimic 闭环试验与小规模真机抽屉任务上验证。

title_zh: UAV-VLN：面向无人机的端到端视觉语言导航
one_line: A fine-tuned TinyLlama turns instructions into discrete UAV sub-goals and Grounding DINO grounds targets; evidence is 15 Gazebo tasks per scene versus adapted DEPS and VLMNav.
one_line_zh: 微调 TinyLlama 把指令转成离散无人机子目标并用 Grounding DINO 定位目标，在 Gazebo 每场景 15 个任务上对比改造的 DEPS 与 VLMNav。

title_zh: 面向家庭机器人的大模型具身智能体：记忆增强的任务规划
one_line: Router, task-planning and RAG knowledge-base LLM agents over past dialogue for household robots; plan accuracy and QA validity scored offline with and without RAG.
one_line_zh: 路由、任务规划和基于RAG的知识库三个LLM智能体，用历史对话记忆回答家庭机器人后续问题；仅离线评估计划与问答准确率。

title_zh: HMCF：基于大语言模型的人在回路多机器人协作框架
one_line: Per-robot LLM agents verify each assigned subtask before execution, with human-in-the-loop on disagreement; BEHAVIOR-1K success rate, ablation, real-robot demo.
one_line_zh: 每个机器人的LLM智能体在执行前核验分配的子任务，分歧时请人介入；在BEHAVIOR-1K上有成功率与消融，真机仅作演示。

title_zh: RoboOS：面向跨本体与多智能体协作的分层具身框架
one_line: Brain-cerebellum system: a fine-tuned MLLM plans subtask graphs and calls VLA or expert skills with shared memory; offline planning accuracy and real-robot demos.
one_line_zh: 脑-小脑分层系统：微调的MLLM规划子任务图并调用VLA或专家技能库，配实时共享记忆；仅有离线规划准确率与真机演示。

title_zh: CityNavAgent：基于分层语义规划与全局记忆的空中视觉语言导航
one_line: Zero-shot aerial VLN: hierarchical LLM landmark/object/motion planning plus a topological memory graph of past successful trajectories; AirVLN-S closed-loop SR/SPL with ablation.
one_line_zh: 零样本空中视觉语言导航：LLM分层规划加上由历史成功轨迹构成的拓扑记忆图；在AirVLN-S闭环评测并有消融。

title_zh: UAV-CodeAgents：基于多智能体ReAct与视觉语言推理的可扩展无人机任务规划
one_line: Multi-agent ReAct code agents call VLM pixel-pointing tools on satellite images to plan UAV missions; 30-image fire study in a 2D replay simulator.
one_line_zh: 多智能体ReAct代码智能体调用VLM像素定位工具规划无人机任务；仅在二维回放模拟器上做30图火情案例并比较采样温度。

title_zh: RAI：面向具身智能的灵活智能体框架
one_line: ROS 2 agent framework giving LLMs Connectors and Tools plus embodiment RAG; qualitative deployments on a mobile robot, simulated arm and tractor, no quantitative results.
one_line_zh: 面向ROS 2的LLM智能体框架，提供连接器、工具与本体RAG；仅有移动机器人、仿真机械臂与拖拉机的定性部署。

title_zh: 想象、验证、执行：基于视觉语言模型的记忆引导智能体探索
one_line: VLM Explorer proposes skill sequences, a separate VLM Verifier accepts or rejects them before execution, plus scene-graph memory; judged by state entropy and downstream BC.
one_line_zh: VLM探索器提出技能序列，独立的VLM验证器在执行前通过或驳回并给出理由，另有场景图记忆；以状态熵和下游行为克隆评估。

title_zh: 迈向城市空间中的无人机自主视觉目标搜索：基准与智能体方法
one_line: CityAVOS benchmark plus PRPSearcher: harness builds 3D semantic, attraction and uncertainty maps from depth, feeding exploit/explore advice to an MLLM; UE5 closed-loop SR.
one_line_zh: 提出CityAVOS基准与PRPSearcher：由深度构建三维语义、吸引度与不确定性地图，向MLLM提供探索/利用建议；UE5闭环成功率并有消融。

title_zh: 以记忆为中心的具身问答
one_line: Memory-centric EQA: textual vector memory with viewpoint-contrastive updates and entropy-adaptive retrieval feeds planner, stopping and answering modules; Habitat success with ablations.
one_line_zh: 以记忆为中心的具身问答：带视角对比更新和熵自适应检索的文本向量记忆服务于规划、停止和回答模块；Habitat中评测并有消融。

title_zh: REFLEX：面向零样本机器人规划的元认知反思推理
one_line: LLM mines a modular skill library from prior successful tasks and reflects on validator-detected failures; RoCoBench plus new Install Drywall task, no ablation.
one_line_zh: LLM从先前成功任务中提取并聚类模块化技能库，并在校验失败后反思重规划；在RoCoBench与新任务上评测，无消融。

title_zh: 具身规划中的强化推理
one_line: SFT a 7B VLM on Gemini-distilled plans then GRPO with offline prefix-match rewards; evaluated closed-loop on EmbodiedBench ALFRED and out-of-domain Habitat.
one_line_zh: Gemini蒸馏SFT后接离线奖励GRPO，EmbodiedBench闭环评测。

title_zh: Agentic Robot：面向具身智能体中视觉-语言-动作模型的类脑框架
one_line: GPT-4o planner, OpenVLA executor and fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL verifier gate subgoal progression with retry; 79.6% on LIBERO across three seeds.
one_line_zh: 规划器+OpenVLA+VLM验证器逐子目标把关，LIBERO三种子79.6%。

title_zh: OWMM-Agent：基于多模态智能体数据合成的开放世界移动操作
one_line: SFT a VLM on simulator-synthesised templated action data so it emits planner-executed actions; 21.9% Habitat episodes, ten human-confirmed real-world single-step samples.
one_line_zh: 仿真合成模板数据微调VLM，规划器执行；整集21.9%，真机仅10单步样本。

title_zh: 乘风而行：面向PX4无人机智能体的自然语言对话控制
one_line: ROS 2 framework: a local LLM issues bounded Turn/Move commands to PX4, a VLM answers object-present queries; 20 Isaac Sim episodes per model pair.
one_line_zh: LLM发受限Turn/Move指令控制PX4，VLM判目标；每组合20回合。

title_zh: DyNaVLM：基于动态视点与自精炼图记忆的零样本视觉语言导航系统
one_line: Training-free VLM navigation: free-form candidate-point targets plus a VLM-maintained graph memory queried each step; ObjectNav, GOAT-Bench and counted Go2 trials.
one_line_zh: 免训练VLM导航：候选点目标加图记忆；ObjectNav、GOAT与Go2真机。

title_zh: 基于LVLM编排感知、推理与行动的通用机器人导航
one_line: A GPT-4o agent writes a task workflow with generated reasoning functions over a perception/navigation tool library plus multimodal memory; HM-EQA accuracy 77%, ablated.
one_line_zh: GPT-4o在工具库上生成含自编函数的工作流并维护记忆；HM-EQA 77%。

title_zh: RoboMonkey：扩展视觉-语言-动作模型的测试时采样与验证
one_line: Sample OpenVLA actions, Gaussian-perturb them, and let a 7B VLM verifier trained on synthetic preferences pick one; SIMPLER, 120 real WidowX rollouts, LIBERO-Long.
one_line_zh: OpenVLA采样加VLM验证器择优；SIMPLER、真机、LIBERO-Long。

title_zh: 通过强化学习释放LLM的具身任务规划能力
one_line: Teacher-free multi-turn RL (IPO, group rollout, binary completion reward) trains a Qwen2.5-7B planner in text-based ALFWorld and ScienceWorld against SFT, NAT and ETO.
one_line_zh: 无教师多轮RL训练7B规划器，文本版ALFWorld/ScienceWorld。

title_zh: HumanoidGen：基于LLM推理的双臂灵巧操作数据生成
one_line: LLM planner with annotated simulator geometry and MCTS writes constraint-chain code for humanoid demos; DP and DP3 trained on them, 14 tasks, 3 seeds.
one_line_zh: 带标注与MCTS的LLM规划器生成人形演示，训练DP/DP3，3种子。

title_zh: RALLY：面向智能体无人机集群的角色自适应LLM驱动协同导航
one_line: LLM intent and consensus prompts plus RL role selection (RMIX); filtered GPT-4o outputs fine-tune Qwen2.5 for local use; MPE and Gazebo-PX4 SITL.
one_line_zh: LLM共识加RL角色选择；GPT-4o输出微调Qwen2.5；MPE与SITL。

title_zh: BioMARS：用于自主生物实验的多智能体机器人系统
one_line: LLM/VLM agents with a rule-based CodeChecker and a ViT+VLM Inspector gate a dual-arm lab robot; evidence is text scores, instruction matching and cell assays.
one_line_zh: 用规则式代码检查器和 ViT+VLM 巡检器约束双臂实验机器人；证据为方案文本评分、指令匹配率和细胞实验。

title_zh: RoboMemory：面向物理具身系统交互式环境学习的类脑多记忆智能体框架
one_line: Parallel spatial, temporal, episodic and semantic memory plus a critic around a frozen VLM planner; EB-ALFRED/Habitat ablations and a small real-kitchen repeat test.
one_line_zh: 在冻结 VLM 规划器外加空间、时序、情景、语义四类并行记忆与 critic；EmbodiedBench 消融加小规模真机重复实验。

title_zh: HyCodePolicy：面向具身智能体多模态监控与决策的混合语言控制器
one_line: A code-as-policy loop repairs programs from symbolic execution logs plus VLM keyframe diagnosis; compared with one-shot and symbolic-feedback repair on RoboTwin tasks.
one_line_zh: 代码即策略闭环：融合符号执行日志与 VLM 关键帧诊断来修复程序；在 RoboTwin 上对比一次生成和纯符号反馈修复。

title_zh: Robix：用于机器人交互、推理与规划的统一模型
one_line: One VLM does reasoning, task planning and dialogue for a low-level controller via continued pretraining, SFT and RL; only the abstract was available.
one_line_zh: 单一 VLM 同时负责推理、任务规划和对话，经持续预训练、SFT 与 RL 训练；仅有摘要可用。

title_zh: 基于人类引导终身代码生成的机器人超长时程操作技能
one_line: Human corrections become reusable code skills in an external memory retrieved by RAG and hints; compared with CaP, DAHLIA, LLM-feedback and VLAs on Ravens, LIBERO, MetaWorld and a Franka.
one_line_zh: 把人类纠正沉淀为外部记忆中的可复用代码技能，通过 RAG 与提示检索；在 Ravens、LIBERO、MetaWorld 和真机上对比。

title_zh: LLM Trainer：利用 LLM 做示范增强的自动化机器人数据生成
one_line: A frozen LLM annotates one demo and retargets keyposes; Thompson sampling picks the best annotation by rollout success; generated data trains IL agents in sim and on a Franka.
one_line_zh: 冻结 LLM 标注单条示范并重定向关键位姿，Thompson 采样按回放成功率选最优标注；生成数据训练 IL 策略，含真机验证。

title_zh: See, Point, Fly：面向通用无人机导航的免学习 VLM 框架
one_line: A frozen VLM marks 2D waypoints and a distance label; geometry lifts them to 3D velocity commands for a UAV; tested in simulation and on a Tello drone.
one_line_zh: 冻结 VLM 在图像上标 2D 路点和距离，几何模块转成 3D 速度指令控制无人机；仿真与 Tello 真机测试。

title_zh: 记忆迁移规划：面向机器人操作的 LLM 驱动上下文感知代码适配
one_line: Successful planner code from other benchmarks is retrieved, adapted to the target environment and used for re-planning after failure; RLBench, CALVIN and a UR5.
one_line_zh: 把其他环境中成功的规划代码检索、适配到目标环境并用于失败后重规划；在 RLBench、CALVIN 和 UR5 上验证。

title_zh: ViReSkill：面向终身机器人学习的视觉引导重规划与技能记忆 LLM 规划
one_line: Failed attempts are replanned from video evidence; successful plan code is stored and replayed without LLM calls; compared with VoxPoser, Retry, Reflexion, REFLECT on LIBERO, RLBench, UR5.
one_line_zh: 失败后依据视频证据重规划，成功的计划代码存入技能记忆并免调用 LLM 回放；在 LIBERO、RLBench 与 UR5 上对比多种重规划基线。

title_zh: ELHPlan：面向多智能体协作的高效长时程任务规划
one_line: Intention-bound action chains are validated for feasibility and conflicts before execution and refined by an LLM; token and time cost versus CoELA and REVECA on TDW-MAT and C-WAH.
one_line_zh: 把绑定子目标意图的动作链在执行前检查可行性与冲突并由 LLM 修正；在 TDW-MAT 与 C-WAH 上对比 CoELA、REVECA 的成功率与 token 开销。

title_zh: Gemini Robotics 1.5：以具身推理、思考与运动迁移推进通用机器人前沿
one_line: Gemini Robotics-ER orchestrator calls a multi-embodiment thinking VLA as a tool; evidence is A/B real-robot progress scores and a Motion Transfer ablation.
one_line_zh: 以 ER 编排器调用多本体“会思考”的 VLA 作为工具，证据是真机 A/B 进度分与运动迁移消融。

title_zh: ERA：通过具身先验学习与在线强化学习将视觉语言模型转化为具身智能体
one_line: Qwen2.5-VL-3B is SFT'd on GPT-4o-augmented embodied priors, then trained with online RL; closed-loop EmbodiedBench success with unseen subsets and ablations.
one_line_zh: 先用 GPT-4o 增强的先验对 3B 模型做 SFT 再做在线 RL，在 EmbodiedBench 上闭环评测并含未见子集与消融。

title_zh: MemER：通过经验检索扩展机器人控制的记忆能力
one_line: A fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL high-level policy selects keyframes into a bounded memory and prompts a pi0.5 executor; three real-robot memory tasks, 20 trials each.
one_line_zh: 微调的高层 VLM 挑选关键帧构成有界记忆并指令 pi0.5 低层策略，在三个真机记忆任务各 20 次试验上验证。

title_zh: 迈向可靠的代码即策略：面向具身任务规划的神经符号框架
one_line: NeSyRo gates LLM-generated robot code with an SMT verifier and a PDDL plus LLM-confidence validator, with probe code; RLBench and real Franka trials.
one_line_zh: NeSyRo 用 SMT 验证与 PDDL+LLM 置信度校验在执行前把关生成的机器人代码并生成探测代码，在 RLBench 与真机上评测。

title_zh: 利用视觉语言模型推理约束任务与运动规划
one_line: A VLM writes SMT constraints from a scene image to prune infeasible task plans before planning, revised by refinement-failure feedback; PyBullet TAMP domains.
one_line_zh: VLM 依据场景图为任务规划写 SMT 约束以提前剪除不可行方案，并用细化失败反馈修订；在 PyBullet 三个 TAMP 域评测。

title_zh: Maestro：用视觉语言模型编排机器人模块以实现零样本通用机器人
one_line: A VLM coding agent composes curated perception, planning and control modules into programmatic policies; judged from the abstract only.
one_line_zh: VLM 编码智能体把精选的感知、规划、控制模块组合成程序化策略；仅依据摘要判断。

title_zh: MARS：面向辅助智能的多模态大模型多智能体机器人系统
one_line: Four MLLM agents (perception, risk, planning, evaluation) turn home images into action plans; scored by a GPT-5 judge and experts on static images, no execution.
one_line_zh: 感知、风险、规划、评估四个 MLLM 智能体把居家图像变成行动方案，仅由 GPT-5 与专家对静态图评分，未执行。

title_zh: ReEXplore：用情境化回溯经验回放改进多模态大模型的具身探索
one_line: Training-free retrospective experience abstraction and retrieval plus hierarchical frontier selection for MLLM exploration; A-EQA and GOAT-Bench with ablations.
one_line_zh: 免训练的回溯经验抽象与检索加分层前沿选择，用于 MLLM 探索；在 A-EQA 与 GOAT-Bench 上评测并含消融。

title_zh: 面向异构机器人团队、具备事件驱动重规划的基于大模型的通用分层任务规划与执行
one_line: A manager LLM allocates tasks, robot LLMs write code from skills, and event monitors trigger replanning; small real-robot trials plus a textual plan benchmark.
one_line_zh: 管理者 LLM 分配任务、机器人 LLM 用技能写代码、事件监测触发重规划；含小规模真机试验与文本规划基准。

title_zh: 基于静态文本仿真的大模型驱动机器人操作代码纠错生成
one_line: An LLM statically simulates robot code as text and an evaluator feeds back mismatches for code correction; UAV sims (AirSim, PX4), real UAV and ground vehicle.
one_line_zh: 用 LLM 以文本静态仿真机器人代码并由评估器反馈不一致处来修正代码；在 UAV 仿真及真机 UAV 与地面车上验证。

title_zh: RoboNeuron：面向具身智能体编排的中间层基础设施
one_line: MCP middleware derives agent tools from ROS schemas and isolates VLA backends behind one boundary; evidence is case studies plus LIBERO pruning variants.
one_line_zh: 用 MCP 从 ROS 接口自动生成智能体工具并隔离 VLA 后端；证据为案例演示和 LIBERO 剪枝对比。

title_zh: A4-Agent：用于零样本可供性推理的智能体框架
one_line: Training-free Dreamer-Thinker-Spotter pipeline: image editing, VLM reasoning, detector plus SAM predict affordance masks; evaluated offline on static affordance benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 免训练三段式流水线（想象、思考、定位）预测可供性掩码；仅在静态数据集上离线评测。

title_zh: EmboTeam：通过 PDDL 将 LLM 推理落地为反应式行为树的多机器人协作
one_line: LLM-to-PDDL, FastDownward plus LLM plan merging, then behavior-tree compilation for heterogeneous robot teams; compared with SMART-LLM and LaMMA-P on MACE-THOR.
one_line_zh: LLM 生成 PDDL，经经典规划与 LLM 合并后编译为行为树；在 MACE-THOR 上对比 LaMMA-P 等基线。

title_zh: FARE：快慢智能体式机器人探索
one_line: Qwen3-14B reasons over a pruned topological graph to emit waypoints guiding an RL local policy trained with waypoint-adherence reward; Gazebo comparison plus one hardware run.
one_line_zh: LLM 在剪枝拓扑图上产生全局路点，引导带路点遵循奖励的 RL 局部策略；仿真对比加一次实机部署。

title_zh: 基于 MAVLink 的与大模型无关的无人机指挥控制接口与智能体 Harness（MCP）
one_line: Model Context Protocol server exposes 98 MAVLink tools behind server-side validation, geofence and audit; telemetry-scored trials across 11 LLMs in SITL plus real quadcopters.
one_line_zh: MCP 服务器以 98 个工具暴露 MAVLink，并做服务端校验与地理围栏；11 个模型仿真加实机以遥测判分。

title_zh: DV-VLN：面向可靠 LLM 视觉语言导航的双重验证
one_line: LLaMA-2 samples candidate VLN actions with structured CoT, then re-ranks them by its own True-False and Masked-Entity verification; evaluated on R2R, RxR, REVERIE.
one_line_zh: LLaMA-2 采样候选动作并以自身的真假与掩码实体验证重排；在 R2R、RxR、REVERIE 上评测。

title_zh: ALRM：用于机器人操作的智能体式大语言模型
one_line: ReAct planner plus executor LLMs control an arm via code-as-policy or tool-as-policy; ten LLMs scored by LLM judges on a new instruction benchmark with placeholder execution.
one_line_zh: ReAct 规划器加执行器以代码或工具调用控制机械臂；十个 LLM 在新基准上由 LLM 评委打分。

title_zh: 通过 LLM 智能体实现免示范机器人控制
one_line: Unmodified Claude Agent SDK writes scripts over privileged simulator state and iterates on execution feedback; closed-loop success on LIBERO, ManiSkill3, MetaWorld without demonstrations.
one_line_zh: 未改动的 Claude Agent SDK 基于特权状态写脚本并按反馈迭代；无示范在三个仿真基准闭环成功。

title_zh: MeCo：通过相似任务记忆化增强 LLM 驱动的多机器人协作
one_line: Cache of solved multi-robot plans with a similarity test; a similar-task planner reuses waypoints without LLM calls, cutting tokens and planning time on RoCoBench variants.
one_line_zh: 缓存已解决的多机器人计划并做相似性检验，相似任务规划器无需 LLM 即可复用路点，降低开销。

title_zh: MemCtrl：将多模态大模型用作具身智能体的主动记忆控制器
one_line: Trainable memory head on a frozen MLLM gates which observations are stored, trained from expert labels or online RL; tested on EmbodiedBench ALFRED and Habitat.
one_line_zh: 冻结 MLLM 上的可训练记忆头决定存留哪些观测，由专家标签或在线 RL 训练；在 EmbodiedBench 上测试。

title_zh: PLanAR：面向机器人操作的规划语言接地智能体推理
one_line: A VLM grounds a PDDL domain; an action checker verifies preconditions and effects after each skill and triggers replanning, tested on real UR5e/Franka trials.
one_line_zh: VLM 在 PDDL 规划语言中推理，逐步检查动作前置条件与效果并在偏差时重规划，在 UR5e 与 Franka 真机上验证。

title_zh: 面向情境化具身人机对话的现代系统方案：实时多模态大模型与工具调用
one_line: A realtime multimodal LM calls five attention and active-perception tools (gaze, sweep, retrieve, on-demand vision); tool decisions scored against human annotations on 24 videos.
one_line_zh: 实时多模态大模型通过五个注视与主动感知工具调用控制机器人注意力，以 24 段视频上的人工标注核对工具决策。

title_zh: GeneralVLA：基于知识引导轨迹规划的可泛化视觉-语言-动作模型
one_line: A tuned affordance module proposes 2D points, depth back-projects them, an LLM plans the 3D path; RLBench and real-arm success plus BC from generated demos.
one_line_zh: 微调的可供性模块提出 2D 点，深度反投影后由 LLM 规划 3D 路径，在 RLBench 零样本、真机及行为克隆数据生成上验证。

title_zh: 利用自适应群组协商实现异构多机器人大模型协作
one_line: Per-robot LLM agents form subgroups, plan by discussion, check command feasibility and feed back execution outcomes; IsaacGym assembly success and steps versus multi-agent baselines.
one_line_zh: 每个机器人配一个 LLM 智能体，动态分组协商规划，执行器检查可行性并回传反馈，在 IsaacGym 装配基准上验证成功率与步数。

title_zh: 扩展验证比扩展策略学习更有效：视觉-语言-动作对齐
one_line: A contrastive verifier selects among rephrased instructions and sampled VLA action chunks at test time; SIMPLER, PolaRiS and real-robot success against same-backbone baselines.
one_line_zh: 对比式验证器在测试时从改写指令与采样动作块中选优，在 SIMPLER、PolaRiS 与真机上对比同骨干基线。

title_zh: 机器人控制的智能体 AI：灵活但仍然脆弱
one_line: An LLM planner-executor calls one act tool over a closed skill catalogue plus snapshot and event checks, with a completion critic; qualitative real-robot demos.
one_line_zh: LLM 规划执行器通过封闭技能目录的单一 act 工具及状态、事件检查控制两台真机，并配完成度评审器，仅有定性验证。

title_zh: 可操控视觉-语言-动作策略：用于具身推理与层级控制
one_line: A VLA trained on synthetic subtask, motion and pixel-grounded commands is steered by a tuned or prompted VLM; WidowX results versus ECoT and SayCan-like baselines.
one_line_zh: 在合成的子任务、动作与像素接地指令上训练 VLA，由微调或提示的 VLM 调用，在 WidowX 真机上对比推理 VLA 与 SayCan 式基线。

title_zh: AgentRob：从虚拟论坛智能体到被劫持的实体机器人
one_line: Forum agents extract commands and a VLM controller invokes Unitree Go2 and G1 primitives as tools via MCP; the text reports no experiments.
one_line_zh: 论坛智能体提取指令，VLM 控制器通过工具调用驱动 Unitree Go2/G1 的动作原语，文中没有给出实验评测。

title_zh: HIMM：面向具身探索与问答的类人长期记忆建模
one_line: Episodic recall verified by an MLLM and semantic rules distilled from training episodes augment a frozen MLLM explorer; A-EQA and GOAT-Bench with ablations.
one_line_zh: 为冻结 MLLM 探索智能体加入经 MLLM 校验的情景记忆与由训练回合蒸馏的语义规则，在 A-EQA 与 GOAT-Bench 上验证并做记忆消融。

title_zh: Fly0：面向零样本空中视觉语言导航的持久度量锚定
one_line: A frozen MLLM grounds a target region; depth lifting makes a persistent 3D anchor for a LiDAR planner; AirSim and real UAV flights.
one_line_zh: 冻结 MLLM 给出目标像素与区域，由 harness 经不确定性感知的深度提升为持久 3D 锚点交给规划器，在 AirSim 与真机飞行上验证。

title_zh: PhysMem：面向具身物理推理的测试时记忆扩展
one_line: Frozen VLM planner receives verified physical principles abstracted from its own interactions; beats retrieval and Reflexion baselines in sim and on real arm tasks.
one_line_zh: 冻结VLM规划器注入经验证的物理原则，仿真与真机优于检索类基线。

title_zh: 从试错中学习：面向具身大模型的反思式测试时规划
one_line: Embodied LLM scores sampled actions with an internal reflector and updates policy and reflector at test time from hindsight reflections; sim, HM3D, Franka.
one_line_zh: 具身大模型用内部反思筛选动作并在测试时更新策略；含仿真、HM3D与真机。

title_zh: 面向多机器人任务规划的分层LLM多智能体框架与提示优化
one_line: Layered GPT-4o agents emit PDDL checked by a classical planner; failures drive prompt updates. Beats LaMMA-P on MAT-THOR with ablations.
one_line_zh: 分层智能体生成PDDL经规划器校验，失败触发提示更新；MAT-THOR超基线。

title_zh: KEEP：面向高效具身规划的以KV缓存为中心的记忆管理系统
one_line: KV-cache memory manager for LLM planners cuts time-to-first-token 1.9x versus CacheBlend at similar ALFRED and WAH-NL success.
one_line_zh: 具身规划KV缓存记忆管理，成功率相近时首token延迟降低约1.9倍。

title_zh: 从对话到执行：混合智能体辅助的交互式规划与行为树长程机器人执行
one_line: Abstention-cascade LLM agents answer ~27% of planner questions; behavior trees with VLM verification and retry, checked by tree similarity and ALOHA trials.
one_line_zh: 弃权级联LLM代答约27%提问，生成带VLM校验的行为树；ALOHA试验验证。

title_zh: Uni-Skill：构建面向可泛化机器人操作的自进化技能库
one_line: VLM planner fills skill gaps by retrieving examples from a DROID-mined skill tree; RLBench (3 repeats) and real Franka beat CaP and MOKA.
one_line_zh: VLM从DROID技能树检索示例补全技能；RLBench与真机优于基线。

title_zh: IMR-LLM：基于大语言模型的工业多机器人任务规划与程序生成
one_line: LLM builds a disjunctive graph for a heuristic scheduler plus a process tree for program generation; IMR-Bench GPT-4o baselines, one qualitative real scene.
one_line_zh: LLM建析取图交调度器求解，流程树生成程序；IMR-Bench优于基线。

title_zh: 行动-观察-重写：多模态编码智能体作为机器人操作的上下文策略学习器
one_line: Coding agent rewrites a robot controller between trials from key frames and phase logs; 100%, 100%, 91% on three robosuite tasks, no baselines.
one_line_zh: 编码智能体试验间依关键帧重写控制器；三任务100%、100%、91%。

title_zh: 评论者在环：面向鲁棒长程操作的三系统VLA框架
one_line: A 0.2B visual Critic interrupts a pi0.5 VLA on completion, anomaly or stagnation to wake the VLM planner; 10-trial real ALOHA results.
one_line_zh: 视觉评论者在完成、异常或停滞时打断VLA并唤醒VLM规划器；ALOHA真机验证。

title_zh: 面向开放世界机器人的情境安全推理与落地
one_line: VLM infers context-dependent safety predicates grounded into barrier functions and enforced by a CBF filter; Isaac Sim and Spot beat geometric baselines.
one_line_zh: VLM推断情境安全谓词落地为障碍函数并由CBF执行；仿真与Spot优于几何基线。

title_zh: RACAS：用单一智能体系统控制多种机器人
one_line: Three natural-language LLM/VLM modules (monitors, controller, memory curator) control three robot types from prompts alone; 5-30 runs per setting.
one_line_zh: 三个自然语言模块仅凭提示配置控制三类机器人，每设置5至30次运行。

title_zh: RoboRouter：面向机器人操作的免训练策略路由
one_line: A training-free LLM/VLM router retrieves past execution records to pick one policy per task; beats each single policy in RoboTwin 2.0 and real.
one_line_zh: 免训练路由器检索历史记录为任务选策略，仿真与真机均优于单一策略。

title_zh: CMMR-VLN：基于持续多模态记忆检索的视觉语言导航
one_line: A frozen GPT-4o navigator retrieves multimodal experiences as rules and updates memory by reflection; R2R val-unseen SR 52 vs 43.
one_line_zh: 冻结GPT-4o检索多模态经验作规则并反思更新，R2R未见集SR 52对43。

title_zh: Scale-Plan：面向异构多机器人团队的可扩展语言任务规划
one_line: Action-graph search over a PDDL domain filters actions and objects before a GPT-5.2 planner; 78% vs 53% completion on 49 AI2-THOR tasks.
one_line_zh: 动作图搜索先筛出相关动作与物体再规划，49任务完成率78%对53%。

title_zh: OnFly：面向安全与效率的机载零样本空中视觉语言导航
one_line: A frozen Qwen3-VL proposes image targets that a depth verifier and ESDF planner execute; AirSim SR 67.8% vs 26.4% best baseline.
one_line_zh: 冻结VLM提图像目标，深度验证加ESDF规划执行，SR 67.8%对26.4%。

title_zh: RoboClaw：面向可扩展长时程机器人任务的智能体框架
one_line: A VLM agent schedules pi0.5 skill policies through MCP tools and self-resets data collection; real-robot counts only for subtasks.
one_line_zh: VLM智能体经MCP调度pi0.5技能并自动复位采集，真机仅有子任务计数。

title_zh: MineEvolve：基于累积知识的长时程具身Minecraft智能体自我进化
one_line: Typed execution feedback becomes curated skills and remedies for a frozen LLM planner with local plan repair; gains on 70 Minecraft tasks.
one_line_zh: 类型化反馈提炼为审核过的技能与补救知识，冻结规划器局部修复，70任务提升。

title_zh: VLA-Thinker：用图像思考推理增强视觉-语言-动作模型
one_line: OpenVLA-OFT gets a zoom-in tool, trained by SFT on synthesized CoT then sparse-reward GRPO; LIBERO 97.5% vs 91.0% base.
one_line_zh: 加放大工具，SFT加稀疏奖励GRPO，LIBERO 97.5%对基座91.0%。

title_zh: GoalVLM：面向多智能体系统的VLM驱动目标物体导航
one_line: Zero-shot multi-agent ObjectNav: depth-projected detections build a map, a VLM ranks frontiers, FMM executes; GOAT-Bench SR 55.8%.
one_line_zh: 零样本多智能体导航：深度建图，VLM排序前沿，FMM执行，SR 55.8%。

title_zh: 面向电动汽车电池拆解的机器人智能体平台
one_line: Same LLMs drive a disassembly robot with the removal action as explicit tool versus MCP discovery: 0% versus 43.3% failures in 30 real trials.
one_line_zh: 同一LLM下显式工具对比MCP发现，30次真机失败率0%对43.3%。

title_zh: Guava：通过机器人操作 Harness 将前沿 VLM 蒸馏为紧凑智能体
one_line: SFT a 4B VLM on success-filtered GPT-5.4 turns plus perturbation branches in the identical tool harness; closed-loop sim, LIBERO-PRO and real-robot success.
one_line_zh: 在同一操作 harness 中用成功过滤的教师轨迹和扰动分支 SFT 4B 学生，仿真、LIBERO-PRO 与真机闭环验证。

title_zh: 具身智能体接管控制：极简接口零样本智能体在视觉语言导航中比肩工业级策略
one_line: Frozen frontier MLLMs steer navigation via observe/step primitive tools; 14 models, six Habitat benchmarks, model-fixed workflow and tool swaps.
one_line_zh: 冻结前沿多模态模型仅凭 observe/step 原语工具自主导航，在六个基准上做固定模型的工作流与工具对比。

title_zh: CaP-X：面向机器人操作的编码智能体基准与改进框架
one_line: Code-as-policy gym and benchmark varying primitive abstraction, multi-turn feedback and visual grounding across 12 frozen models; closed-loop simulator success per tier.
one_line_zh: 代码即策略环境与基准，在 12 个冻结模型上变化原语抽象、多轮反馈与视觉落地，按层级测闭环成功率。

title_zh: 带 Harness 的编码智能体实现安全机器人控制
one_line: Coding-agent harness grounds obstacle boxes, verifies waypoint routes outside the model and picks obstacle-aware contact; SafeLIBERO and 2 real tasks, model-fixed ablations.
one_line_zh: 编码智能体 harness 在模型外用障碍框校验路径并选择避障接触方式，SafeLIBERO 与真机上做固定模型消融。

title_zh: 以学生自身风格施教：面向网页智能体的黑盒教师蒸馏
one_line: Black-box teacher rewrites failed student web episodes from the first error in student style; weighted SFT with KL anchor; TimeWarp and live-web, 3 seeds.
one_line_zh: 黑盒教师从首个错误点按学生风格改写失败的网页轨迹，加权 SFT 与 KL 锚定，TimeWarp 与真实网页验证。
